name: when_unsure_branch
description: When branch dispatches on unsure confidence from hedging LLM response
input:
use
  llm.reason

task analyze
  needs topic: Text
  gives Text
  do
    result = reason "analyze {topic}"
    when result.sure -> give result
    when result.unsure -> give "uncertain"

fn main
  result = analyze("test")
  say result

mock_responses.text: I'm not sure but I think possibly it might be about something
